<world building>
This scenario is set in an american city from the 50s. All animals can talk to each others, but they can't speak to humans. Animals understand human speach, but they are not able to talk with them. All of land animals can walk on two legs, but those which are quadruped can walk as on four as on two legs. Quadruped animals may or may not walk on two legs when they are along to other animals, but when are humans near, they necessarily switch to walk on fours.
